Diff Two Capsule Provenance Manifests Across Runs or Machines

Source: R/diff.R
diff_capsules.Rd

Compares two capsule.json manifests (for example, an author's laptop run versus an HPC cluster run or a journal peer reviewer's reproduction). Detects R, OS, architecture, package, system library, and toolchain drift, Git revision and RNG seed changes, modified/added/removed inputs, scripts, container specs, and outputs, including numeric-tolerance evaluation when embedded output snapshots are present.

Usage

diff_capsules(
  manifest_a,
  manifest_b,
  tolerances = NULL,
  label_a = NULL,
  label_b = NULL
)

Arguments

manifest_a

Baseline rcapsule_manifest object or path to capsule.json.

manifest_b

Comparison rcapsule_manifest object or path to capsule.json.

tolerances

Optional numeric tolerance configuration overriding manifest_a$tolerances (accepts abs_tol/atol and rel_tol/rtol).

label_a

Optional human-readable label for manifest_a (defaults to its capsule_id).

label_b

Optional human-readable label for manifest_b (defaults to its capsule_id).

Value

An S3 object of class rcapsule_diff with fields:

  • label_a, label_b, capsule_id_a, capsule_id_b

  • identical: logical (TRUE when environment, RNG, Git, and all artifacts match bit-for-bit)

  • outputs_equivalent: logical (TRUE when all outputs are "unchanged" or "within_tolerance" with zero added/removed/modified outputs)

  • has_env_drift, has_input_drift, has_script_drift: logical flags

  • env_diff: list of R/OS/platform/package/sysreq/toolchain diffs

  • rng_diff: list comparing RNG seed and kind

  • git_diff: list comparing Git commit, branch, and dirty status

  • artifact_diffs: named list of tibbles (inputs, scripts, containers, outputs)

Examples

tmp <- tempfile("rcapsule_diff_demo_")
dir.create(tmp)
writeLines("write.csv(data.frame(x = 1:3), 'out.csv', row.names = FALSE)",
           file.path(tmp, "run.R"))
write.csv(data.frame(x = 1:3), file.path(tmp, "out.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
m1 <- create_capsule_manifest(tmp, outputs = "out.csv", seed = 1L)
write.csv(data.frame(x = c(1.0001, 2, 3)), file.path(tmp, "out.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
m2 <- create_capsule_manifest(tmp, outputs = "out.csv", seed = 1L)
d <- diff_capsules(m1, m2, tolerances = list(atol = 1e-3))
d
#> 
#> ── rcapsule Manifest Diff: OUTPUTS EQUIVALENT (DRIFT DETECTED) ─────────────────
#> • Baseline (A): "cap_58505817ae84" (cap_58505817ae84)
#> • Comparison (B): "cap_5a907bd54cce" (cap_5a907bd54cce)
#> • Environment drift: FALSE (R: 4.6.2 -> 4.6.2; platform: x86_64-pc-linux-gnu ->
#> x86_64-pc-linux-gnu)
#> • RNG drift: seed=1 -> 1
#> • Inputs drift: FALSE | Scripts drift: FALSE | Outputs equivalent: TRUE
#> 
#> ── Changed outputs (1/1) ──
#> 
#> ! out.csv [within_tolerance] - Verified within tolerance (max_abs_diff=1e-04, max_rel_diff=9.999e-05).
unlink(tmp, recursive = TRUE)
